The '''''Smelly Saint''''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that smuggled ripoff [[Agri-Droid]]s out of the [[Kimm systems]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. It was apparently connected to [[Fargednim P'taan]].
